recommendation.text: The Board recommends that the Administration review, refine and harmonize the accountability framework for monitoring the exercise of delegated decision-making authority with the property management performance assessment framework to prevent duplication and overlap of efforts and to enable the appropriate, timely and effective monitoring of the quantitative as well as qualitative aspects of the management of property, in compliance with the applicable policy framework.
